verdict: TRUTHFUL FAILED A/B. On ls20 with the ornith35b-arc text-only model, BOTH the EWM world-model agent and the reactive baseline completed 0 of 7 levels. The EWM agent's distinguishing mechanic (synthesize an executable world model, then plan against it with a search planner) never engaged: the 35B model could not author a Python world-model program that passed validation against the observed 64x64 ls20 frames, so program_adopted=false and the agent spent the run in reactive RECOVER mode -- effectively degenerating to the same reactive strategy as the baseline, just under a larger action budget. Net: no measurable advantage from the EWM machinery on this game with this model, because the bottleneck is the model's inability to bootstrap a valid world model from a cold, complex ARC frame, not the harness. The live wiring itself worked end-to-end (real game session opened, 70 actions submitted, scorecard opened and closed cleanly).
